title: Grade 5 6.05
description: Learning Outcomes for Grade 5: Identify appropriate units of capacity | Convert litres and millilitres | Convert litres to millilitres | Convert millilitres to litres | Compare capacities | Convert decimal litres to millilitres | Compare equivalent capacities | Compare metric capacities | Convert decimal capacities | Apply capacity conversions in context | Convert capacities in real-world situations | Solve capacity problems involving addition

questions.solution: Use the key clue in the question and apply the lesson method step by step. This leads to mL; L; km.
